# crosswork_l2vpn_id_pools (Resource)

This resource can manage the association of the L2VPN with resource pools.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_l2vpn_id_pools" "example" {
  evi_id_pool            = "cwtest-l2-evi"
  evi_source_target_pool = "cwtest-l2-evi-st"
  rt_pool                = "cwtest-l2-rt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `evi_id_pool` (String) Pool of the automatic EVI ids (`auto_evi_id` of a service)
- `evi_source_target_pool` (String) Pool of the automatic EVI source and target (`auto_evi_source` and `auto_evi_target` of a service)
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `rt_pool` (String) Pool of the automatic route targets

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_l2vpn_id_pools.example "l2vpn_id_pools"
```
